# Event reference

<!-- Generated by scripts/generate_reference.py from the Rust EventKind enum. Do not edit. -->

Every event kind with its default log level. Kinds can be selected with glob patterns
(`"message.*"`) in `client.on(...)` and `LoggingConfig(levels=..., disabled=...)`. Also
available as `fanferro events`.

| Kind | Default level | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `resource.found` | debug | A queue, topic or subscription was found during provisioning. |
| `resource.created` | info | A queue, topic, subscription or bucket was created. |
| `resource.updated` | info | Resource attributes or tags were updated to match the spec. |
| `resource.drift` | warning | Resource attributes differ from the spec and were not updated. |
| `resource.missing` | warning | A resource does not exist and was not created. |
| `resource.failed` | error | Provisioning a resource failed. |
| `resource.fallback` | warning | A provisioning fallback handler supplied the resource. |
| `resource.policy_updated` | info | A queue policy was updated to allow an SNS topic to send messages. |
| `resource.deleted` | info | A resource was deleted (teardown). |
| `publish.succeeded` | debug | A message was published to a topic or sent to a queue. |
| `publish.failed` | error | Publishing a message failed after retries. |
| `publish.retried` | warning | Failed batch entries are being retried. |
| `payload.offloaded` | debug | A large payload was stored externally and replaced by a pointer. |
| `payload.fetched` | debug | An offloaded payload was downloaded. |
| `payload.deleted` | debug | An offloaded payload object was deleted after processing. |
| `consumer.starting` | info | A consumer is starting. |
| `consumer.started` | info | A consumer started receiving messages. |
| `consumer.paused` | info | A consumer paused receiving. |
| `consumer.resumed` | info | A consumer resumed receiving. |
| `consumer.stopping` | info | A consumer is shutting down. |
| `consumer.draining` | info | A stopping consumer is waiting for in-flight messages. |
| `consumer.stopped` | info | A consumer stopped. |
| `consumer.error` | error | A consumer hit an unrecoverable error. |
| `receive.succeeded` | debug | A receive call returned messages. |
| `receive.empty` | debug | A receive call returned no messages. |
| `receive.failed` | warning | A receive call failed; the consumer backs off and retries. |
| `message.received` | debug | A message was received and leased. |
| `message.decode_failed` | error | A message could not be decoded (transport, envelope or codec). |
| `message.unroutable` | warning | No route matched a message. |
| `message.processed` | debug | A handler processed a message successfully. |
| `message.failed` | warning | A handler raised an error for a message. |
| `message.duplicate` | info | A message was skipped as an already processed duplicate. |
| `message.acked` | debug | A message was deleted from the queue. |
| `message.ack_failed` | warning | Deleting a message failed; it may be redelivered. |
| `message.retry_scheduled` | info | A failed message will become visible again after a backoff delay. |
| `message.requeued` | info | A failed message was sent back to the queue as a new message. |
| `message.dead_lettered` | warning | A message was forwarded to the dead-letter queue. |
| `message.dead_letter_failed` | error | Forwarding a message to the dead-letter queue failed. |
| `message.released` | debug | A message was made visible again without processing. |
| `message.dropped` | warning | A message was deleted without being processed. |
| `lease.extended` | debug | Message visibility was extended by the heartbeat. |
| `lease.extension_failed` | warning | Extending message visibility failed. |
| `lease.lost` | warning | The receipt handle became invalid; the message may be processed twice. |
| `lease.expired` | warning | The maximum lease duration was reached; heartbeats stopped. |
| `sns.subscription_confirmed` | info | An SNS subscription confirmation was confirmed automatically. |
| `hook.failed` | error | An event hook or middleware raised an exception. |
| `config.warning` | warning | A configuration combination is likely a mistake. |
| `events.dropped` | warning | Events were dropped because the event buffer was full. |
